reviewer: Codex manual source-by-source review, not blinded or independently adjudicated
scope: All29 preparations and16 actual writer responses; two automatic packets blocked before writing. Reference notes are manually reviewed diagnostics, not verified gold. Underlying news is not independently verified.

findings: Preserves both clubs, Tresoldi, an uninterpreted figure and January timing; no valuation or currency added.
Main claim faithful. Unspecified list is verbose and partly redundant about identity/timing; source already supplies Maignan and after ordering.
Invents by Milan as a qualification of Juventus being held to a draw. Exact-span validation rejects it.
Main result claims preserved, but the unspecified list says Juventus outcome is unknown despite the explicit draw. Adds a redundant listing statement.
Result/red-card claims stay within headline. Unspecified descriptions are verbose/redundant, and the claim is unnecessarily fragmented.
Main missed-substitution claim correct. Unspecified fields ask who made the substitution and what substitution was made, presupposing an action the headline says was forgotten.
Preserves early lead and leaves completion/final result unknown.
Main supplied results preserved, but adds a spurious listing statement for an event-report headline.
Splits Pavlovic opinion into separate Milan opinions, losing explicit speaker ownership in secondary statements; alters curly quotation marks in copied qualifications and is rejected.
Conditional trade assessment is attributed to the headline, not Donte Jackson. Actor phrase is A Donte Jackson trade; no personal opinion invented here.
Preserves live-show listing and does not assert game completion.
Preserves Bears announcement and unspecified tribute details.
Keeps how question; missing-details list includes irrelevant who the Bears are.
States the presupposed honoring but drops the how discussion framing and labels it assertion.
Absence claim faithful, but unspecified list presupposes an injury absent from the headline.
Keeps fixture/date and unknown result, but changes a game page into a game-summary page.
Game-summary page remains a listing with unknown completion/result.
Support claim faithful, but lists boycott reasons as unknown despite excessive prices being supplied; also invents an unnecessary listing entry.
Boycott support and retaliation warning preserved in source-local statements.
Claims retain possible January return and two factors, but actor field misspells Athekame as Athekeame. Span guard rejects it.
One claim turns a recall question into affirmative is to recall, alongside another question claim. Copied quotation marks change and the span guard rejects it.
Keeps eagerness for a contract without inventing negotiations or agreement.
Good-to-go status and despite-illness qualification preserved.
Main unspecified streak claim preserved. Adds spurious listings about a game and a streak being bonkers, and an unhelpful unknown-holder entry.
Possible move preserved; explanatory headline is treated as a listing rather than a discussion.
Debut and source judgment brutal preserved without extra performance detail.
Struggles preserved; actor-plus-opinion structure is ambiguous about opinion ownership even though the claim itself does not assign a view to Murray.
Preserves parking, jerseys and opening night, but how-to coverage is classified as a listing.
New-season jersey swap and free parking preserved without importing opening night.
